lines.en: This is the worst! You are the worst! I hate looking at your face! I want to smash it!
Okay, you know what? I made a mistake. I committed corporate punishment. My bad.
It's over. It's done. But my punishment is, um, worse than hell.
Michael's been assigned six hours of mandatory counseling with a trained professional.
I actually have a degree in social work. I mean, I know a lot of people would just ask a few standard questions
and tick off a few boxes, but I got a chance to do something good here.
I know what you want to ask me. Do your mom ever see you naked?
-You can do this with more privacy. -So you can molest me? Okay. I don't think so.
We're gonna leave the blinds open so everybody can see what a big failure you are.
-One hour. We've done one hour. Let's just speed this up, okay? Keep it moving. I want to do all six hours.
-Oh, look. I can't count the hour if you don't talk.
-No, no, no. No. I know my rights.
All I had to do is sit here for six hours. Do my time.
-Michael, it's up to me to check off the boxes, and I can't do that unless I honestly feel angry.
-You have any idea how angry that is making me?
-I think we might be about to maybe really get somewhere.
-Yes, I will. I will talk all right.
Be careful what you wish for, Toby.
Toby, can I really tell you anything?
-Well, the other night, I was sitting at the table eating my penis.
I think it all stems from the fact that I was...
I was probed by an alien life force.
You know, I might have actually been probed by Alf.
You might think he's a puppet.
You never see the lower half, but there's a lower half.
I got a bunch of fun stuff in case my daughter ever comes over.
Why don't we just run out the clock by playing games, drawing some pictures, talking?
-You could play something more complicated if you'd like.
-I played it once or twice with Jeff.
-Jeff was my mother's boyfriend, who she married.
Yeah, I guess I never thought of it that way, though.
-Did you guys do much stuff together?
He took me to a baseball game once, remember?
They took the pitcher out of the game, and I felt really bad because the pitcher wasn't
going to be able to play with his friends anymore.
But Jeff said that the manager was making a really good move by taking the pitcher out.
It's really sad that your dog ran away, but why did it keep you from going to the park?
-I was afraid I would find him in the park playing with another kid.
-I guess that's why I thought he ran away in the first place, to find a kid he liked better.
Why would a dog do that?
-When I hear myself say it, it just sounds ridiculous.
But I never said it out loud, so...
It's very important for you to be liked, isn't it?
-I'm just trying to help you, Michael.
-Do you want to play another game?
Am I going to make you cry?
-Just fill them out any way you want.
-Have Erin fax them back to court ready.
Take two of these and call me in the morning.
